record.title: Guerguerat COVID passenger closure, March 2020 to November 2021 permission
record.scope: Passenger crossing between Moroccan-administered Western Sahara and Mauritania
record.movement: Travellers and private or tourist vehicles; mixed passenger/goods transport was affected.
record.exceptions: Professional freight traffic remained permitted under the health regime.
record.enforcement: Field reporting documents stranded travellers and vehicles near the crossing.
record.consequences: Interrupted passenger journeys; scale not quantified.
record.relationship: Separate health restriction from NA004, the October–November 2020 protest blockade affecting the same corridor. Link geographically; do not add their overlapping border-days. Separate later Omicron regime R4-AWN-004.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; not a present-day status assessment
record.context: Restrictions affected ordinary passenger travel along the coastal route. Western Sahara is disputed territory; Moroccan administration is identified without treating sovereignty as settled.
record.uncertainty: 10 November is local authorities’ stated effective permission, not a traffic observation. EFE later refers to a 9 November decision. No continuous all-traffic closure is implied.

historical.duration_note: Formal change of permission; operational reopening and continuous effective duration not established. 18 March 2020 to 10 November 2021 is an order-to-permission chronology; no operational continuous duration calculated.
